summary: P0-F.13.1 FINAL Cisco Secure Endpoint Device Trajectory baseline conformance pass — frontend only. Ran authenticated tests against /xdr/edr/device-trajectory?device=dev_42e8c6dc74b9 across all 14 items of the acceptance matrix. 12/14 items PASS. 2 items FAIL (24h scrubber handle/band drag, and deep-scroll Files & Network section/lane/glyph DOM emission is inconsistent). Notable additional finding: on fresh load amp-filters-button shows 'Filters (1)' because the default 'Last 24 hours' timeframe chip is counted, causing initial workspace to render 'No activity rows in this slice' with an empty Activity pane until the analyst clicks a day cell.

ui_bugs.issue: amp-nav-handle-right and amp-nav-band do NOT respond to mouse drag — amp-nav-window text and amp-nav-hatch-after width never change across slow multi-step drags in 3 attempts. Day-cell clicks and Shift+wheel already move the window fine, so bug is scoped to the handle/band pointer handler.

When data-row-start reaches 450+ (Files & Network), amp-canvas can render zero amp-event-*, zero data-lane-group, zero amp-section-*; gutter stays '[ System ]'. In another run the section DID render visually — inconsistent virtualization state.

Fresh page load shows amp-filters-button reading 'Filters (1)' and the initial workspace renders 'No activity rows in this slice' with an empty Activity pane. The pre-applied filter is the 'Last 24 hours' timeframe chip counted as (1); analyst sees blank canvas until a day cell is clicked.

issues: Both themes legible; nav band, hour band, hatch, canvas, gutter, activity list, details drawer all readable. No white-on-white or dark-on-dark elements.

action_items: Wire up pointer/mouse drag on AmpNavigator amp-nav-handle-right + amp-nav-band (item #6 of acceptance matrix is blocked). Likely need setPointerCapture on the SVG root and bind pointermove on window instead of the tiny 12×44 handle.

Fix AmpCanvas virtualization so deep-scroll (row 450+) consistently renders the Files & Network section, its data-lane-group=FILE|NETWORK elements, its amp-event-* circle glyphs, and updates amp-gutter-system text.
Do NOT count the default 'Last 24 hours' timeframe chip in the amp-filters-button badge — on fresh load 'Filters (1)' + empty workspace is misleading.
critical_code_review_comments: AmpNavigator.jsx — verify onPointerDown/onMouseDown on amp-nav-handle-right and amp-nav-band actually calls setPointerCapture (or attaches a window-level pointermove listener). The current handle bbox 12×44 is too small to keep the pointer inside during drag.

AmpCanvas.jsx — virtualized lane rendering appears to short-circuit when the visible lane range exceeds a small pre-loaded lane set; clamp data-row-start to (rowTotal − viewportRows) or load lanes on-demand for the deep range regardless of the active filter.
EdrDeviceTrajectoryPage.jsx — the filter counter includes the default timeframe. Exclude defaults from the count or seed the workspace with content on landing.

AmpIcons.jsx / AmpCanvas.jsx — every amp-event-* wraps the semantic glyph in a transparent <circle r=7.5> hit-target followed by a <rect> for process, which makes shape-based test assertions brittle. Add data-glyph='process|network|file|dns|registry|detection|iam' to the outer <g> so tests and screen readers can rely on semantic type instead of DOM shape peeking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two real functional bugs remain: (A) 24h scrubber handle/band drag doesn't move the window (item #6 blocked); (B) deep-scroll DOM emission for Files & Network section/lane-group/circle-glyphs is inconsistent (item #7 partial). All other 12 acceptance items PASS. When re-testing, avoid clicking amp-nav-day-2026-09-06 before verifying the deep-scroll section — in one run scrolling from initial state populated Files & Network correctly, in another run after clicking that day cell it stayed empty. 'Filters (1)' badge on fresh load counts the default Last-24-hours chip. Connectors are entirely correct: 31 amp-connector-<n> elements, all <path> elbows, all data-*-lane-index/parent-in-view attrs, lineage pre-order preserved. Screenshots saved: dark_theme.png, light_theme_v2.png, files_network_v3.png, deep_scroll_final.png, activity_details.png.
rca_of_the_issue: Item #6 scrubber drag: AmpNavigator likely attaches onPointerMove on the handle element itself instead of window/document; as soon as the 12px-wide handle loses pointer capture the drag stops. Recommend: onPointerDown → target.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); onPointerMove/onPointerUp bound on the same target OR bind them to window with the pointerId in a ref. Item #7 deep-scroll rendering: AmpCanvas keeps computing top-visible section from an initial lane set; when the filter narrows the axis and the user still wheel-scrolls, data-row-start increments past the end of loaded lanes without clamping, so the SVG becomes a labelless '[ System ]' shell. Item on Filters(1): timeframe chip 'Last 24 hours' is counted in the filter badge even though it's the default — cosmetic but misleading and produces an empty canvas on landing.
